message:
I remember a particularly blustery winter when the snow came down in such a hurry that it seemed like the sky had decided to throw a giant confetti party. I had just stocked up on some extra supplies—nothing fancy, just some canned soup and a few flashlights. 

When the power went out, my grandkids and I huddled together in the living room, armed with those flashlights and our cozy blankets. We turned our impromptu candlelight dinner into a storytelling session, sharing silly tales and laughing like we were at a comedy club. 

Turns out, that little bit of preparation made a big difference in turning a dreary night into a cherished memory. Sometimes, it’s the small wins that save the day. What’s your favorite little tip for making tough weather a bit easier?
